correctness.rationale: Dyadic matrix-product identity and a nonzero-commuting product contradiction prove mutual annihilation. The maximal family proof gives both containment and closure under adding vertices. Projective scalar quotient counts its size; the middle-rank extremum follows convexity. Double subspace-lattice Möbius inversion counts each unordered clique exactly once by its unique two spans. Exhaustive six-case direct matrix checks reproduce every coefficient and each maximal clique size; experiments are corroboration, not infinite proof.

value.rationale: Determines a complete natural invariant of the induced nilpotent commuting graph: exact Grassmannian maximal cliques at all ranks, maximum size and multiplicity, and all clique-polynomial coefficients over every finite field. The rank-stratified q-Möbius formula is a substantive global enumeration not conveyed by local degree/common-neighbor statistics. It supplies the face numbers of a natural flag complex uniformly in dimensions and field sizes.
